NARRATIVE AND PLANS
IN SUPPORT OF AN APPLICATION FOR A TYPE | MAP AMENDMENT
OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO ZONING MAP
FOR THE PROPERTY COMMONLY KNOWN AS
3037-47 WEST CARROLL AVENUE/317-31 NORTH ALBANY AVENUE

Applicant seeks a Type | Map Amendment of the City of Chicago Zoning Map from the
current M1-2 District to that of a B2-5 District for the property commonly known as 3037-47
West Carroll Avenue/317-31 North Albany Avenue. The site is improved with a multi-story
formerly industrial building whose total lot area is 35,079 square feet. Applicant seeks to
use the existing building as artist workshops and studios (non residential).

The followingis a list of the existing bulk and density of the development:

Lot Area: 35,079 (existing)

Density: 0 residential dwelling units

Lot Area Per Unit: n/a

Off Street Parking: 0 spaces (existing)

Height: approximately 73 feet 8 inches (existing)
Floor Area: approximately 98,900 square feet (existing)
Floor Area Ratio: approximately 2.82 (existing)

Front (North) Setback: 0 feet (existing)
Rear (South) Setback: 0 feet (existing)*
East Side Setback: 0 feet (existing)
West Side Setback: 0 feet (existing)

*seeking 17-3-0405-B(2) Variation for reduced rear setbacks
